accepted.title: Finite asymptotic dimension for all Artin groups
accepted.text: For a finite graph Γ whose edges have integer labels mₐᵦ≥2, let AΓ=⟨VΓ | alternating(a,b,mₐᵦ)=alternating(b,a,mₐᵦ) on every edge⟩. Give AΓ a word metric. Asdim X≤d means that for every R>0, X admits a uniformly bounded cover such that every R-ball meets at most d+1 sets. Does every AΓ have finite asymptotic dimension?
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory

accepted.scope_review: Every finitely generated Artin group; no finite-type, large-type or hyperbolic-type restriction. Distinct from the stronger clique bound.
accepted.literature_finding: Tselekidis current arXiv2203.05746 gives special-case bounds and retains the general conjecture. Hagen–Martin–Sisto2109.04387 proves finite dimension for extra-large and large/hyperbolic type only. Fresh searches found no all-Artin closure.

accepted.title: Artin asymptotic dimension bounded by clique number
accepted.text: For a finite graph Γ whose edges have integer labels mₐᵦ≥2, let AΓ=⟨VΓ | alternating(a,b,mₐᵦ)=alternating(b,a,mₐᵦ) on every edge⟩. Give AΓ a word metric. Asdim X≤d means that for every R>0, X admits a uniformly bounded cover such that every R-ball meets at most d+1 sets. Writing Sim(Γ) for the number of vertices in a largest clique, must asdim AΓ≤Sim(Γ)?
accepted.subject: Group Theory & Geometric Group Theory
